edges.reason: msg.sender is compared to owner in onlyOwner protecting transferOwnership.
msg.sender must own the token before approve records the approved address.
msg.sender is checked against _from, monsterAuction and approval in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the bidder recipient of the ETH refund inside _buy.
buy forwards msg.value and msg.sender to _buy before token transfer.
msg.sender identity drives currChampion and ranked power checks in contestChampion.
onlyAdmin gates createPromoMonster through msg.sender == adminAddress.
onlyAdmin gates createGen0Auction through msg.sender == adminAddress.
spawnMonster requires msg.sender == gameContract.
evolveMonster requires msg.sender == omegaContract.
createTrainer keys trainer creation on msg.sender ownership.
setMonsterCreatorAddress is restricted by onlyAdmin on msg.sender.
setMonsterAuctionAddress is restricted by onlyAdmin on msg.sender.
setGameLogicContract is restricted by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
setOmegaContract is restricted by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
creationBlock is initialized from now, making it timestamp dependent.
_createMonster stores birthTime from block.timestamp.
_createTrainer stores the trainer birthTime from block.timestamp.
createAuction stores startedAt from uint64(now), which also drives _isOnAuction.
_createMonster calls _transfer to assign the new token.
_createTrainer mints a starter by calling _createMonster.
transferFrom performs the ownership change through _transfer.
takeOwnership delegates to transferFrom.
buy invokes _buy which performs external ETH transfers before returning.
createAuction escrows the token through _escrow.
createPromoMonster mints via _createMonster.
createGen0Auction mints via _createMonster.
createGen0Auction calls monsterAuction.createAuction.
spawnMonster mints through _createMonster.
createTrainer calls the internal _createTrainer.
_transfer increments ownershipTokenCount without overflow protection.
_transfer decrements ownershipTokenCount without underflow protection.
_buy computes fee through _computeCut multiplication and division.
_buy decrements ownershipAuctionCount for the seller.
cancelAuction path decrements ownershipAuctionCount for the seller.
createPromoMonster increments promoCreatedCount without overflow protection.
createGen0Auction increments gen0CreatedCount without overflow protection.
rand derives its result from block.blockhash and an internal nonce.
seller.transfer sends ETH to an externally controlled address during _buy.
msg.sender.transfer refunds excess ETH to the caller during _buy.
withdrawBalance forwards the whole balance to owner via transfer.
_escrow makes an external call to nonFungibleContract.transferFrom.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is only meaningful as the from-argument of MonstersBase._transfer.
_to is only meaningful as the to-argument of MonstersBase._transfer.
_tokenId is only meaningful as the token-argument of MonstersBase._transfer.
_bidAmount is consumed exclusively by the auction settlement logic in _buy.
_price is only used to build the Auction struct inside createAuction.
_seller is only used to populate the Auction seller and counters in createAuction.
_owner is only used as the mint recipient in createPromoMonster.
_mId is only used to validate and mint the promo monster.
_to is only meaningful as the destination of transferFrom.
newOwner is only used to reassign the owner state variable.
_tokenId is only used to read the contender's stats in contestChampion.
myPowerlevel is a computed local used only for ranking checks in contestChampion.
_receiver is only used as the destination of the escrow transfer.
_owner is only used as the source of the escrow transferFrom.
min is only used to clamp the rand result.
max is only used as the modulo bound in rand.
